description: This line plot illustrates the Accuracy@1 (%) for two large language models, GPT-4o and Claude-3.5-Sonnet, as a function of the number of child nodes, also referred to as Tree Width, which ranges from 1 to 7 on the linear x-axis. The y-axis represents Accuracy@1 (%) on a linear scale, spanning from 15% to 35%. The GPT-4o model is depicted by a solid blue line with circular markers, starting at an accuracy of 24.4% at Tree Width 1, rising to a peak of 34.7% at Tree Width 5, and then decreasing to 31.1% at Tree Width 7. The Claude-3.5-Sonnet model is shown by a dashed light purple line with star markers, beginning at 26.7% at Tree Width 1, increasing slightly to 27.8% at Tree Width 3, and then declining to 20.0% at Tree Width 7.
